why_best: The structured mosaic breakdown provides a crisp, high-tech rhythm that fits the authoritative newsroom register while comfortably filling the extended eight-second pause.
why_bad: A simple organic blur or cinematic cross-dissolve would feel too soft and narrative-driven, undermining the sharp, data-dense tone of a modern news broadcast.
trap: A near-miss would clear all the digital blocks simultaneously, turning a dynamic broadcast transition into a flat, artificial graphic overlay.
